/.title: Auxilium Specialty | Insurance for Frontier Technology Risk

/products/ai-liability.title: AI Liability Insurance | Auxilium Specialty
/products/ai-liability.description: Standalone AI liability. Eight insuring agreements under one aggregate. Five pay your own loss on discovery, with no claim required. Placed through surplus lines brokers.

/coverages.title: Coverages | Auxilium Specialty
/coverages.description: Insuring the industrial revolution: the risks of autonomy across the digital and physical worlds. AI liability for the businesses that run AI and the vendors that build it, three robotics lines, and the risk-mitigation software that comes with the policy.

/about.title: About Auxilium Specialty | Insuring Industrial Revolutions
/about.description: A managing general agent insuring the industrial revolutions of the AI era, with reinsurance rigor and quantitative underwriting for the risks incumbents exclude or misprice.

/partners.title: Partners: Brokers and Carriers | Auxilium Specialty
/partners.description: Place frontier-technology risk with Auxilium, or build capacity as a carrier or reinsurer. AI Liability and the robotics lines are placed through licensed brokers.

/insights.title: Insights | Auxilium Specialty
/insights.description: Analysis on AI liability, agent governance, and the emerging risks of frontier technology from the Auxilium Specialty underwriting team.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Auxilium Specialty
/privacy.description: How Auxilium Specialty collects, uses, and protects information across its insurance and software offerings.

/terms.title: Terms of Service | Auxilium Specialty
/terms.description: The terms governing use of the Auxilium Specialty website, software, and services.

/coming-soon/auxcontrol.title: AuxControl: active risk mitigation for insureds | Auxilium Specialty
/coming-soon/auxcontrol.description: The risk-mitigation suite included with an Auxilium policy: adversarial testing of deployed agents, accreditation, and continuous governance.

/products/ai-vendor-certification.title: AI Vendor Liability and Agent Certification | Auxilium Specialty
/products/ai-vendor-certification.description: For companies that build and sell AI agents. Certify each agent on an adversarial range, then insure your liability for it: technology E&O, contractual indemnity and product liability, with accumulation capped per vendor.

/coming-soon/robot-maker-liability.title: Robot Maker Liability, in development | Auxilium Specialty
/coming-soon/robot-maker-liability.description: Liability for robot makers, vendors and system integrators: injury and damage caused by their robots, failure to perform and faulty software, cyber-physical harm, with customers added as insureds and no AI exclusion.

/coming-soon/fleet-protection.title: Automaton & Fleet Protection, in development | Auxilium Specialty
/coming-soon/fleet-protection.description: For every company running robots: breakdown and accidental damage, downtime after failure, hacks that cause harm and liability above your general liability policy. Through your broker or your robot vendor's lease.

/coming-soon/home-humanoid-protection.title: Home Humanoid Protection, in development | Auxilium Specialty
/coming-soon/home-humanoid-protection.description: Breakdown, accidental damage and liability in the home for household humanoid robots, with optional theft cover, offered by the robot maker at checkout or in the subscription.
